description:
Hello,

We are 5th-grade students at TED Ankara College. We are a group of young people who love space and our world. We welcome anyone who is curious about space and the solar system to join our group.
summary: Our project aims to enable people to identify potential wildfire-prone areas globally, thereby helping them take proactive measures within their own countries. Furthermore, it seeks to facilitate the characterization of the Moon and Mars, foster a better understanding of space exploration, and mitigate the impact of misinformation.
details:
Our project combines satellite-based wildfire monitoring, planetary analog research, and Mars exploration mapping to address important challenges on Earth and beyond.

By harmonizing MODIS and VIIRS active fire observations, we aim to reveal historical fire patterns and identify critical periods for early warning and emergency response.

We compare Earth's extreme environments with the geological and environmental features of the Moon and Mars to identify valuable planetary analog sites.

Finally, we integrate NASA's Mars datasets into a layered exploration map to help future astronauts identify scientific targets, understand environmental hazards, and plan safer missions.
